jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_apostle_sp: A tall, gaunt instance that rises where an infected person fell, with %s health. It does not stay where it rose.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_spewer_spa: A vast rooted mass with %s health. It breathes out clouds and the ground around it turns to flesh.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_villager_s: What is left of a villager, with %s health.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_pig_spawn_: What is left of a pig, with %s health. Most of it is mouth.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_cow_spawn_: What is left of a cow, with %s health.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_sheep_spaw: What is left of a sheep, with %s health.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_chicken_sp: What is left of a chicken, with %s health.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_horse_spaw: What is left of a horse, with %s health. It is fast.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_crawler_sp: A small, quick instance with %s health, grown from something small.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_shambler_s: A lurching instance with %s health, grown from something the size of a person.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_hulk_spawn: A massive instance with %s health, grown from something large.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_amalgam_sp: A hulking mass of many mouths with %s health. Its origin is unknown.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_colossus_s: A towering instance with %s health. Its origin is unknown.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_herald_spa: A walking sack with %s health. It keeps its distance and breathes clouds.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_tendril_wo: A toothed tendril with %s health that grows out of SCP-610 flesh.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_tender_spa: A small, soft instance with %s health. It keeps close to the others and does not fight.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_weaver_spa: A many-legged instance with %s health that works over the flesh around a hive.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_harvester_: A heavy forager with %s health. It carries things home.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_burrower_s: A segmented digger with %s health. It is hard to pin down.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_spore_bear: A small walking sack with %s health. It wanders far from the hive.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_brood_sac_: A rooted, pulsing sac with %s health. Something moves inside.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_siege_brut: A huge armoured instance with %s health. Walls do not stop it for long.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_stalker_sp: A low, quiet instance with %s health.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_spitter_sp: A tall instance with %s health that attacks from a distance.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp610_matriarch_: An enormous, ancient instance with %s health. The others gather around it.
Its touch and its blows carry SCP-610.

jei.scp_unleashed.info.vial.scp610.1: A sealed sample of SCP-610: a dark, meaty fluid. While the seal holds it is inert.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.vial.scp610.2: An open sample infects anyone within %1$s blocks with a clear line of sight. Only a complete hazardous materials suit offers protection.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.vial.scp610.3: Infected people worsen over several stages. Infected animals do not last long.

We were many, once. Separate. Afraid. Then the flesh joined us, and we stopped being afraid.
We are what is left when the walls between bodies come down.
Every pig, every villager, every soldier who walked too close. All of them. Us, now.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp610.lord.terms: Every %2$s turns of the light, bring us %1$s pieces of raw meat. Be late, and we grow back into your world.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp610.lord.slain: Below you, something screams in a thousand voices.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp610.0: The courier brings a sealed red sample by hand, held at arm's length.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp610.1: Meet them in the open and fully suited. Keep it sealed.
dossier.scp_unleashed.610.title: The Flesh that Hates
dossier.scp_unleashed.610.caption: A mature SCP-610-2 mass in the lower observation chamber.
dossier.scp_unleashed.610.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.610.page.0.text.0: The SCP-610 sample is held in a single sealed vial inside a powered viral storage locker. The seal is not to be broken outside a sealed test chamber.
dossier.scp_unleashed.610.page.0.text.1: Personnel entering any area where SCP-610 is active must wear a complete hazardous materials suit. Partial protection, including gas masks worn alone, is not acceptable. **Personnel showing signs of infection are to be isolated at once.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.610.page.0.text.2: SCP-610 growth found outside containment is to be destroyed. Every SCP-610-2 mass is to be located and destroyed, including any growth beneath it. Recovery teams are not to enter SCP-610 tunnels without full protection and lighting.
dossier.scp_unleashed.610.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.610.page.1.text.0: SCP-610 is a contagious organism that converts living tissue into an aggressive mass of exposed muscle and sinew. It is carried on the air near infected tissue and passes on contact.
dossier.scp_unleashed.610.page.1.text.1: In humans, infection begins as small patches of raw muscle on the hands and neck. Over the following hours the patches spread across the body, and subjects report weakness, hunger and a persistent wet cough.
dossier.scp_unleashed.610.page.1.text.2: Infected animals do not survive long. Their bodies are overtaken within minutes and they rise as SCP-610-1 instances, hostile to all uninfected life. Instances keep only a rough impression of the original animal.
dossier.scp_unleashed.610.page.1.text.3: Humans who die while infected rise as tall, gaunt instances designated SCP-610-1-A ('Apostles'). Apostles do not remain where they rise. They wander, apparently searching, until they root themselves in place and swell into a large immobile mass designated SCP-610-2.
dossier.scp_unleashed.610.page.1.text.4: SCP-610-2 masses release clouds of infectious matter and cover the surrounding ground in living tissue. Most of a mass's growth takes place underground, where it hollows out tunnels and chambers lined with flesh.
dossier.scp_unleashed.610.page.2.title: Addendum 610-1: Recovery Log
dossier.scp_unleashed.610.page.2.text.0: Team Theta-4 descended into the chambers beneath an SCP-610-2 mass at %r[REDACTED]%r. Team members described tunnels 'like a throat' and low rooms held up by columns of sinew.
dossier.scp_unleashed.610.page.2.text.1: Contact was lost at a depth of roughly thirty metres. The final transmission described a large, quiet room and 'something in the far wall, watching us'. The team was not recovered.
dossier.scp_unleashed.610.page.3.title: Addendum 610-2: Observations
dossier.scp_unleashed.610.page.3.text: Instances larger than any recorded host have been reported near mature masses. Their origin is unknown.
dossier.scp_unleashed.610.page.4.title: Addendum 610-3: Provenance
dossier.scp_unleashed.610.page.4.text: SCP-610 has no recovery record. It was delivered to a reader of this file. See field notes.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp610.lord.greet: A voice. One voice. How small it sounds, alone inside its one skin.
You came down into the gut of us, and you knock. Like a guest. We have never had a guest.
We taste you through the wet. Salt. Iron. Fear. You are mostly water and fear.
So the separate ones learned to speak in smell. Speak, then. We listen with every mouth.
Closer. No. Stay there. We like to see all of you, while all of you is still yours.
You return, and your skin is still yours. Shall we talk about how long it stays yours?
We can be still. We can be slow. Stillness has a price, and the price is meat.
Ask us to stop. Go on. We have waited a long time for a mouth like yours to ask.
Each day we spread a little, and each day your ground is less. Bargain, or lose more.
Back again, to talk in the dark. Lonely, in one body? We are never lonely.
We are still. Feel it? All that hunger, holding its breath for you.
The pact holds. Our roots ache against it. Remember who is aching.
We count the light as it turns. We count very well.
You keep us fed. We keep ourselves small. A good arrangement. For now.
Your kind sleep easy above us. They do not know whose patience keeps them whole.
Hungry. The light has turned, and every mouth of us is empty.
You are late. Not yet too late. We can smell the difference.
The pact grows thin as skin. Feed it, or we tear through it.
We ache. Every root, every gut. You promised. Bring what you promised.
Our stillness is starving. Starving things do not stay still.
Good. Still warm. We are... content. The feeling will pass.
The meat was good. We passed it through all of us. Every mouth tasted it.
Sated, for now. Go up into your light. We will lie still in the dark.
You fed us well. We almost forget that we want you too.
Full. Quiet. Do not mistake quiet for asleep.
Liar. We tasted your promise, and it was rot.
The pact is torn. We are growing again. Hear it? The cracking, under your feet.
You come back to us? After that? Your skin is very brave, or very stupid.
We remember. All of us remember. Flesh does not forget a wound.
Speak quickly, small one. Every word is a breath we spend not eating you.
It hurts. You did that. All of us felt you do that.
Our eye weeps, and a thousand mouths scream with it. Can you hear them, up there?
Wounded. Not dying. We will close over this. Then it is your turn.
You cut us. We will keep the shape of your blade in every scar.
Pain is only flesh, learning. We are learning you.
We are not a sickness. Sickness ends. We are only the shape the world takes next.
You call yourself one. One heart, one mouth, one death. We pity that. We hate it.
Ask the ground. Ask the roots. We have heard you through both, for a long time.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp610.lord.terms: Yes. We will be still. We will not reach for the surface. Not for nothing.
Agreed. Our roots will wait in the dark. Waiting is hungry work.
A pact, then. We hold still. You hold up your end. Flesh for flesh.
We will stop. We will stop. Feel how hard it is for us to say that.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp610.lord.refus: No. You had our stillness, and you spat it out.
We do not bargain twice with the same lie. Not yet.
No pacts while the wound is fresh. Only hunger now.
Stop? We have only just started again.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp610.lord.tribu: Yes. Yes. Warm and red. This is good. Go.
We take it. We take it into all of us. The pact holds a while longer.
Meat. Good meat. You may keep your own a little longer.
It is enough. Our mouths close. For now.
Fed. Still. Your world is safe from us until the light turns again.
That is not enough. Did you think we cannot count?
A morsel. An insult. We are larger than that, small one.
Too little. Come back when your arms are full.
Scraps, for a body this big? Bring more.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp610.lord.price: Meat. Only meat. Red and raw, from bodies like yours, but simpler.
What we always want. To be fed. Feed us, and we stay down here.
You know what we want. We want everything. We will settle for meat.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp610.lord.due_p: Raw meat. %s pieces. Put it in our mouth.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp610.lord.tribu: %s pieces of raw meat. No less.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp610.lord.price: %1$s pieces of raw meat, before the light has turned %2$s more. We are counting.
%s pieces of raw meat. Now. You are already late.
gamerule.scp610UnlimitedGrowth.descripti: When on, SCP-610 hives ignore their size limits and can grow without end. The block change budget per tick still applies.
